content.text: The grant clause meets the preferred position in full.

input.quote: 13.1 Subject to payment of applicable Fees, Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a worldwide, non-exclusive right during the subscription term to access and use the hosted Services and documentation for their internal business purposes and to provide services to Customer.
input.rationale: Section 13 meets the preferred position without qualification: the subscription grant expressly extends to Customer's Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf (13.1, no written-notice condition needed), paid-up/embedded software is licensed on a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free basis to Customer and its Affiliates with contractor support rights (13.2), and Vendor may not revoke or suspend a licence except for material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a cure opportunity (13.3). Licence rights are transferable to an Affiliate or successor under the permitted-assignment right in Section 24.1, which covers M&A and asset sales without Vendor consent, and Section 24.4 bars Vendor from using a change of control to terminate or suspend. No "revocable" or narrow "internal use only" limitation and no walk-away features are present, so no redline is warranted.
